# Neo

> Neo is an all-in-one platform for small businesses offering custom email domains, AI-powered email composition, and website building tools.

Neo helps entrepreneurs and small business owners establish professional online presence through custom email domains, intelligent email writing assistance powered by AI, and integrated website solutions. The platform is available in multiple languages including English, French, Spanish, and German.

## Key Topics

- Custom Email Domains
- Business Email
- Professional Email Address
- AI Email Writer (Smart Write)
- Website Builder
- Domain Registration
- Free Trial
- Small Business
- Email Marketing
- .space Domain
- .me Domain
- Email Setup
- Personal Branding
- Static Website Generators
- Neo Platform
